The `live-post` proposal is clear, so I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. `text-check.mjs` found no flags. The brief gives a specific tool, file, test and restart question, and I didn't change it.

The one nit is the phrase "the ~70 servex tools you'd mark remote-safe". It could be read as "70 tools are safe" rather than "pick the safe ones out of about 70". It is a small ambiguity in an agent-facing brief, so I left it.
